description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the Avg. JGA Score across various Turn IDs for two different models. The horizontal category axis is labeled "Turn ID" and displays numeric categories arranged in ascending order from 0 to 26 at intervals of 2. The vertical value axis is labeled "Avg. JGA Score" and features a linear scale ranging from 0.2 to 1, with numeric tick labels spaced at regular intervals of 0.1. The data is represented by grouped bars at each Turn ID, with each group consisting of two adjacent bars. According to the legend in the upper right, the orange bars represent "LLaMA-7B" and the yellow bars represent "T5-small". For the LLaMA-7B model, the bars exhibit a general downward trend in height from left to right, starting at the tallest value of approximately 0.96 at Turn ID 0 and reaching a low of roughly 0.44 at Turn ID 26. Similarly, the T5-small bars begin at their highest point of about 0.95 at Turn ID 0 and decrease to their shortest value of approximately 0.30 at Turn ID 24. The bar groups are sorted numerically by Turn ID from left to right, and there are no specific visual emphases, such as outlines or annotations, applied to individual bars.
